title: TawheedResponse
description: Output of POST /tawheed/evaluate. Deterministic: the same request bytes under the same policy version produce the same response bytes apart from evaluated_at and request_hash, which are echoes of the input and the call.

decision.description: error is never treated as compliant downstream. There is no implicit default and no optimistic fallback.

code.description: Empty when outcome is compliant or not-applicable. Populated from the rule's on_violation.code otherwise.

inputs_read.description: Field paths the rule actually read. Makes the evaluation reproducible by hand.

redacted_inputs.description: Field paths that were read but withheld by audit.redact. Present rather than omitted, so absence is not itself a disclosure.

actions.description: Side effects the rule requested: notify:, reorder:, quarantine:, reject:, tag:, flag:, require:, block:, unblock:.

message.description: Operator-facing explanation. Never contains evidence content or field values beyond the redacted path list.

request_hash.description: sha256 over the canonicalised request. The reproducibility key: two evaluations are comparable only if their request_hash and policy_version match.

audit_id.description: Reference into tawheed/audit/evaluation-log.md. Present on every response including error, because a failed evaluation that was not recorded is indistinguishable from one that never happened.
